job.title: Contentstack Solution Architect - Freelance at Valtech

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Senior Java & Integration Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs and headless commerce, building composable integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning, and techno-functional analysis of business requirements to drive robust e-commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Contentstack Solution Architect - Freelance
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Valtech’s leadership in composable commerce and its innovative use of Contentstack to deliver flexible digital experiences. With 5+ years designing and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless APIs, integration pipelines and agile delivery that align perfectly with this role.

bullets.label: **SAP Commerce Expertise**
bullets.text: Delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, implementing product, catalog and pricing models that power global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: **API & Integration Leadership**
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST services and engineered PIM-to-ERP data pipelines, ensuring seamless composable commerce integrations across systems.

bullets.label: **Headless & Cloud-Native Delivery**
bullets.text: Implemented headless commerce APIs for storefronts and integrated CI/CD pipelines on CCv2, Docker and Kubernetes for rapid, reliable releases.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Business Partner**
bullets.text: Collaborated with international stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications, user stories and production-ready solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Valtech’s projects.

tailoring.why_company: Valtech is renowned for pioneering composable commerce solutions that empower brands to innovate quickly across channels. Your focus on integrating best-of-breed platforms like Contentstack with flexible e-commerce back-ends matches my experience building headless SAP Commerce APIs and complex PIM-ERP integrations. Joining Valtech would let me apply my technical depth and AI-assisted development skills to accelerate client transformations and drive measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Valtech accelerate composable commerce projects by applying my SAP Commerce, API integration and AI-driven development expertise.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years of headless API and integration experience. I’m keen to bring my expertise to Valtech’s Contentstack solutions. Could we discuss how I can add value?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your Contentstack integrations by extending OCC APIs and linking them to existing PIM/ERP systems, leveraging my proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise. I will also streamline CI/CD pipelines on CCv2, Docker and Kubernetes to ensure rapid, reliable deployments.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Contentstack Solution Architect - Freelance
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience delivering headless, API-driven e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Valtech’s focus on composable commerce and Contentstack aligns with my expertise in OCC APIs, PIM/ERP integrations and cloud-native deployments. I can immediately contribute by enhancing your integration layer and accelerating delivery. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
